root_cause: The real Netlify Identity production canary reached the protected Portal endpoint but /api/portal-ondernemersdata returned HTTP 503. That serverless Function read runtime credentials through Netlify.env, the Edge Functions environment API. Bedrijfsgeheugen had already learned on 2026-09-21 that Netlify serverless Functions must read scoped runtime environment variables through process.env. The configured service credential therefore resolved empty at this boundary and the function failed closed on its SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY_MISSING path.
prevention: Netlify serverless Functions must read runtime secrets and configuration through process.env; Netlify.env is reserved for Edge Functions.
Do not add another credential name, permanent test credential or authentication bypass to mask a runtime API mismatch.
The protected Portal production-proof regression must fail if portal-ondernemersdata reintroduces Netlify.env.
The authenticated production proof remains fail-closed until the exact protected-main deploy returns HTTP 200, verifies tenant scope and payload shape, and deletes its synthetic Identity user.
A production 503 observed after successful Identity authentication must be classified against explicit server failure paths before changing authentication or underlying data.
